summary: End-to-end testing of XamanProtocol (custom phrase-based auth XRP staking). Backend: 19/19 pytest tests pass covering register/login (incl. 409 dup, 401 wrong phrase), state auth, admin CRUD, staking + min/insufficient errors, live accrual, deposit-claim + admin confirm, withdraw pending/approve/reject-refund, admin permission enforcement (403 for user), REAL-TIME server-side enforcement of locked users (stakes/deposit-claim/withdraw all 403) and withdrawals_disabled (only withdraw blocked), audit log, no-store header, and public vaults. Frontend: Create-wallet flow (register -> reveal phrase -> confirm -> setup PIN -> confirm PIN -> /app dashboard) works. Admin recover flow lands on /admin, users list renders 8 users with tier badges, user detail modal opens, credit balance (+5000) updates modal + list + audit ('Deposit ... completed' in recent activity), lock/withdrawals toggles work (welcome toast + 'Withdrawals enabled' toast on revert). User recover on a fresh device correctly prompts a new Set-PIN flow, then lands on /app. Vaults page renders all 5 vaults with correct APYs (5.2/19.2/38.4/83.6/156) and min amounts. Staking dialog (stake-button-xrp_flex -> stake-amount-input -> confirm-stake-button) successfully deducts 500 XRP and creates the active stake displayed on dashboard with 'XRP Flex 5.2% APY Flexible', principal 500, earned live counter, and 'Progress to Silver 500/1000'. Deposit page shows correct hot wallet address + unique destination tag (465960716). Withdraw page shows available balance and request form.

issues: Live yield / earned counter is formatted to 4 decimals; for small principals (e.g. 500 XRP @ 5.2%) it displays 0.0000 for several seconds, which may look static. Not a bug — with 100k @ 156% (Diamond) the counter ticks visibly. Consider showing more decimals or a subtle animation.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 802 lines — nearing the 700-line threshold. Consider splitting into modules (auth, admin, staking, ws) for maintainability.
seed() overwrites admin phrase_hash on every startup — fine for tests but note it does re-run bcrypt on each restart.
adjust_balance uses $inc without a bounds check; negative amounts can drive balance below 0 (admin discretion, but consider protecting).
audit log for adjust_balance always calls it 'deposit'/'adjustment' via add_transaction — semantically ok but the ttype ternary is duplicated.

unique_destination_tag has retry loop of 50 but falls through to a possibly duplicate tag on exhaustion; the sparse unique index will then raise on insert. Acceptable but should surface a clean 500 rather than a raw DuplicateKeyError.
Frontend .env sets REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL without /api suffix; API client must always append /api (ensure that's centralized in api.js — verified via network calls succeeding).

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 19 backend pytest tests pass under xdist. If rerun fails on 'Withdraw insufficient balance', it means user_ctx fixture ran on a fresh worker without admin credit — the fixture now credits 500k upfront so this is stable. Frontend uses <a data-testid=nav-vaults> which is a bottom-nav element hidden on desktop; use `/app/vaults` direct URL or the top-nav 'Vaults' link. Recovery on a device without local vault always requires setting a new PIN before landing on /app.
